Estimate each separately. The acceptance criterion is not a large count of text records; it is one complete path that remains truthful across result variants and saves.

Quest rewards are: accurate record, access to optional testimony, and possibly a newly revealed location lead. None is guaranteed to yield loot or faction favor. Failure states include deadline elapsed, player abandonment, source unavailable, and evidence insufficient; each has a deliberate close or continuation. Repeatability is off for the primary report; a future generic debrief template may be reusable, but a personal witness statement is not. Timed variants use an anchored day at acceptance, visible remaining time, and an authored grace/fallback rule. A player should not discover after loading that an invisible timer quietly removed the only way forward.

### Release rubric

A quest packet is ready for a small playable slice when its purpose can be described in one sentence, its entry event is observable, its objective is measurable, its failure routes still leave the campaign playable, and its reward is honest. For this story, the sentence is: “After a mission fails but the party returns, the player decides what the shelter can truthfully publish.” The owner checklist must identify the result, quest state, speaker availability, evidence source and consequence route. If any item has no current owner, reduce scope or mark the dependency; do not disguise it as narrative flavor. The first content review should reject duplicate versions of the same neutral report, unnecessary sub-quests, and any “success” reward that contradicts the failed objective. Track a completion rate only after the route is wired, and interpret abandonment alongside the clarity of the deadline and blocked-state copy. An optional branch is not a failure if players decline it; a required report that cannot close is.

## Pass 35A — The Order on the Gate Has No Witness

### Quest frame: make doctrine enforcement playable

Part 46 asks which warlord doctrines lack an authored enforcement encounter. The current catalog provides a strong starting point without proving a one-to-one encounter gap: warlord_doctrines.json contains 24 doctrine records; each carries doctrine behavior plus journal_key and radio_key; it does not expose an enforcement_encounter_id field. WarlordDoctrineSystem emits a narrative request when it records a doctrine marker. That is a usable source seam for exploration, but an emitted narrative key is not proof that the player received it, that an enforcement action happened, or that an encounter is reachable. The quest proposal therefore begins with a catalog-and-consumer audit and a narrow playable sample, not 24 unverified claims.

The story is “The Order on the Gate Has No Witness.” A settlement courier brings a stamped rule saying the Toll doctrine has changed the road price. A second copy, kept by a driver, shows a different amount and no signature. The player is not asked to decide which faction record is legally authoritative from typography alone. The quest begins only when a current player-facing channel has delivered the disputed order and the relevant WarlordDoctrineSystem state confirms the doctrine under investigation. Its first action is to collect two independently sourced accounts, using a real encounter or journal/radio content only after verifying its content key, runtime dispatch, and reachability.

The main quest has three completion routes. The player can confirm that an enforcement action occurred and identify its actual source; establish that the order was issued but no enforcement was observed; or close the case as unresolved because sources conflict. Each outcome has a different factual statement and a valid close. The unresolved route must be a legitimate resolution, not a hidden failure state. A timed version is optional and must use an anchored day with a visible deadline; it cannot quietly expire the only way to complete the quest. A repeatable future contract may reuse the audit structure, but the first player-facing case is one-shot and carries a stable identity.

### Candidate side quests and rewards

“Second Copy, First Signature” is an investigation side quest: compare two documents and identify their source, date, and audience. “The Tollman’s Apprentice” is a character quest: the junior clerk can refuse to sign a public notice while still agreeing to explain how the rule was posted. The player may respect privacy, ask for a signed account, or leave the source unidentified. “One Gate, Two Lines” is a faction quest where a driver and a checkpoint worker describe the same event differently; each can be truthful about what they personally saw. An optional late-game variation can examine how repeated enforcement changed the road’s reputation, but it must not alter the current doctrine AI.

Rewards center on access and reliable information: a verified journal record, an unlocked conversation, an authored map clue if a real location becomes known, or an existing standing event when a supported command represents the chosen outcome. No new reputation points, contraband payment, or faction allegiance is implied. Failure states include source unavailable, player declines to publish, a public record has already been issued, and a deadline has expired. Each state needs a close or a remaining valid route. Before authoring all variants, conduct a row-by-row audit of the 24 doctrine keys and all likely enforcement corpora. Never multiply 24 narratives from a single ambiguous doctrine marker.

### Coverage programme: turn twenty-four rows into honest playable scope

The doctrine census should be treated as a work queue with small evidence packets, not as a promise to write 24 full quests. A row graduates through five statuses: catalogued; source key verified; consumer reachability verified; enforcement event linked; player-facing outcome verified. The sample quest can ship at row five for one doctrine. Rows with only a journal/radio key remain observation-only content. Rows that refer to the same strategic action may share a generic evidence-review structure while retaining separate factual predicates. The goal is coverage that players can experience and authors can maintain, not a one-scene-per-ID quota.

Group the twenty-four records by player-visible difference discovered during review, not by the author’s preferred story taxonomy. Several doctrines may use the same strategic action type but differ in timing, target rule, resource priority, transition conditions or public language. For each group, document what the player can actually observe. If the difference affects only internal AI weights and never a player-visible event, it does not need a bespoke quest. If it changes whether a checkpoint demands tribute, whether an occupied position is defended, or whether a faction withdraws, that is a candidate content distinction only after the campaign produces an event with that detail.

Potential quest state model for an enforcement case: inactive until relevant player-facing source exists; available when the doctrine is known; discovered when the disputed action is encountered; accepted by explicit investigation choice; in progress while evidence is gathered; blocked when the campaign has no accessible source; partially completed when one source has been recorded; failed only when a mutually exclusive authored deadline or choice closes the selected route; completed when the case reaches confirmed, contradicted or unresolved closure; resolved when any supported owner-side projection finishes. Abandoning a case should not mutate the Warlord strategy. Reopening requires a new event identity or a newly delivered source, not simply revisiting the journal.

A quest objective is testable if it names an event: “inspect the first notice,” “hear the witness,” “compare the second source,” “select a report.” Avoid objectives like “understand the Toll” or “convince the Warlords” unless there is an owner command and measurable output for those goals. A closed evidence route can be completed without agreeing with the faction, and a player who leaves can resume later. When no source exists, a visible blocked reason such as “No enforcement record has reached the shelter” is better than an empty tracker. The player may still close an optional case as unknown.

Production sequence: census the source keys and actions; choose a doctrine with a proven player observation; draft a single quest record; validate all references; connect to an existing host event; add only one end-to-end consumer; then decide whether a second doctrine warrants another packet. If integration shows no event delivery path, keep the completed quest design as a candidate and do not route it through a UI callback. This work belongs in the core game only if it explains an existing reachable doctrine event; broad twenty-four doctrine coverage is an expansion-scale content programme.

### Playable portfolio: main, character, faction, discovery, and repeatable forms

The portfolio should keep quest types legible. The main investigation follows one doctrine source through notice, verification and report. A character quest follows Ivo’s decision to let a receipt carry his name; a second route honors his request to remain anonymous. A faction quest asks a Warlord clerk and a road worker to explain the difference between written policy and the work performed at the post. A discovery quest is an environmental paper trail found only where a canonical location and encounter already exist. An investigation quest compares sources. A protection variant can escort a witness between two already supported locations only if the expedition/escort owner has an accepted route; otherwise the same character can meet at the shelter. A survival variant uses an existing expedition danger or route decision as context, not a new survival meter. A resource/crafting variant may repair a damaged register case using a real crafting recipe, but belongs in a later expansion slice and only if the item is consumed by an owner. A timed quest may ask for a report before a scheduled faction event, but deadline math is anchored and visible. A hidden quest can begin from a repeatable clue only after the discovery owner supports it. A choice-dependent quest stores the selected doctrine source and never branches from an unobserved AI transition.

The minimum content portfolio is one main quest plus two character/faction side quests. Discovery, escort, crafting, hidden, timed, repeatable and late-game variations are optional layers. Each layer needs purpose, required location, failure state, reward, branch potential, reuse potential, production cost and core-versus-expansion recommendation. The main quest is core candidate if an event route is verified. The escort, multi-location evidence hunt and late-game policy hearing are expansion content because they depend on more owners and multiple location states.

Repeatable quests need special care. A weekly “check the notice” task must not repeat the same factual claim or pay the player for re-reading a catalog key. It could become a rotating reporting contract only if a current task/quest owner supports anchored rotation and each instance has a distinct action-event identity. Otherwise keep the investigation one-shot. A quest can reopen after a new doctrine action without erasing its earlier closeout; that is a new case instance linked to an old thread, not a reset of completed state. The first implementation should not include rotating content.

A blocked case must explain whether the source is not yet authored, not yet delivered, physically inaccessible, or consumed. Only player-facing reasons that are safe to reveal should appear in the tracker; developer logs can retain precise IDs. If the source will never become available in the current run, convert the case to an unresolved closure rather than leaving an infinite blocker. Failed quests continue through a different route only when that route is explicitly written and still supplies a truthful objective. Failure must never automatically alter faction hostility or war state.

### Long-form arc: what a rule costs after it changes

The optional three-act arc “The Register Outlives the Toll” makes doctrine shifts legible across time without giving the quest control of Warlord strategy. Act I gathers the posted order, receipt, and witness distinction. Act II triggers only after a later doctrine-transition event is both committed and discoverable; a second order uses different language, while the old register remains a record of the first. Act III asks whether the settlement wants a public comparison, a private archive copy, or no further publication. The arc can end in four ways: a verified enforcement report; a verified announcement with no observed enforcement; an unresolved contradiction; or a player refusal to make a public claim. All four are complete narrative outcomes.

A doctrine transition is not a player choice, and the player should not be offered dialogue that claims they caused it unless an accepted Warlord command says so. A later doctrine can be selected by campaign conditions such as supply ratio, failure streak, contested territory, environmental hazard, rival pressure, or player tribute reliability. The content should never reveal those internal inputs as if the player saw them. When the player learns about a transition through radio or faction event, the quest can offer a comparative archive action. If no delivered signal exists, the arc waits.

A character arc can follow Nera from rule clerk to records custodian. Her growth is not that she learns to rebel or becomes loyal; she learns to state the limits of a document without hiding behind it. Ivo’s return line after the second order might be: “They changed the mark. They did not change the road under my wheel.” That is a personal observation, not proof that the policy remained identical. The player can ask for a second receipt, ask how the new rule altered work, or leave the old record closed. These options create character texture while keeping exact policy claims with live data.

Late game, a chronicle may acknowledge the accumulated record only if the actual quest case history is an accepted input. The chronology should read “two notices were compared; the second did not resolve who collected the first fee,” not “the Warlords were defeated by paperwork.” The latter invents a political outcome and exaggerates player agency. The arc can still have high stakes: a driver refuses a route, a shelter leader debates whether to publish, a clerk risks being blamed for the missing signature. Drama comes from consequences of uncertainty, not from a guaranteed victory.

The first arc slice is one report and one follow-up. The second adds the later doctrine transition. The third adds optional public response and a late-game callback after the content consumer and save semantics are confirmed. This staged dependency keeps the narrative valuable at each increment and gives production a clean cut line if any event or chronicle bridge remains unavailable.

### Player-facing evidence dossiers and narrative closure

The quest journal should present a concise dossier that is useful to a player but does not replace the canonical source. It can contain title, current objective, known source references, unresolved questions, current deadline if any, and one next action. The full case record belongs to the existing quest/evidence owner. A dossier sentence may say “The broadcast announces a new rule; no collection is confirmed” when those source facts are in state. It must not say “The Tollman’s men have begun enforcing the rule” without a specific event. The summary should retain its uncertainty after loading or reopening the quest.

Closeout is a distinct authored object from success/failure. Each closeout lists: player action; facts established; facts not established; source IDs; any owner-side command result; and follow-up availability. A player who publishes a wrong claim can still complete the quest, but the content should identify that the claim is contradicted only after the game has an authoritative contradiction source. If the current system cannot represent correction, the response can be a new note rather than retroactive rewriting. A closeout can be reviewed later without replaying every conversation.

Quest graph recovery: if a required source is removed by an expansion package update, use a safe neutral closure or preserve the old source definition for active saves. If a character dies or becomes unavailable, the quest does not automatically treat their absence as proof; it can use an earlier recorded statement or remain unresolved. If the location is captured, use the current accessibility route; never teleport the player into the site. If the faction changes doctrine, preserve the historical case identity. If the player is at an incompatible campaign stage, explain that the matter is closed or awaiting the next event. These are authored failure states and migration cases, not extra hidden mechanics.

The lifecycle acceptance set should include: available but no source delivered; discovered via broadcast; accepted and no evidence; partial with one source; full evidence and unresolved close; verified action close; public statement requested but unsupported; report choice saved then reloaded; source removed in update; witness unavailable; doctrine transition arrives late; and explicit abandonment. Verify every path ends in a visible state and that no route completes by merely opening a catalog. A future repeatable case must have a fresh stable case identity and a clear reason it is new. It cannot pay repeated rewards for the same action event.

Content release owners should sign off on a single sample before expansion to all 24 doctrines. The dependency chain is: census result; evidence contract; one sample; player route; consequence contract; accessibility/language review; then cohort expansion. Stop if the sample’s source event cannot be identified. This is a strong stopping rule, not an incomplete deliverable: the audit matrix can still inform content planning without writing scenes for unsupported cases.

### Editorial coverage plan for the twenty-four doctrine records

The current doctrine IDs can be used to organize a writer’s audit, but they must not be mistaken for twenty-four quest requirements. First cluster candidate records by player-observable action differences; then preserve exact doctrine identity in the case metadata. The list includes toll, consolidation, annexation, withdrawal, besiege, traffic, ashprophet, procedure, lightning_raider, vulture_raider, iron_perimeter, layered_redoubt, pressed_ranks, borrowed_voices, toll_kingdom, sacred_campaign, salvage_supremacy, chains_of_work, many_knives, scorched_earth, convoy_interdiction, silent_garrison, proxy_provocation and resource_stranglehold. The authoring census should keep the source ID and current display name together so a future catalog edit does not leave a plan row orphaned.

The census currently shows a mix of preferred goals and action sets: six eligible strategic action names recur across the data—annex, contest, defend, demand_tribute, raid and withdraw—while target rules include nearest_undefended, highest_supply, nearest_chokepoint, isolated_convoy and none. These are behavior inputs, not authored enforcement proof. For each row ask whether the player can observe a concrete distinction, through a resolved event, location state, delivered radio/journal key or a reachable encounter. If no distinction survives that test, share the generic evidence case rather than add unique story copy.

A useful grouping exercise may yield four authoring lanes: collection/tribute; territorial pressure; defense/withdrawal; and covert or indirect action. The labels are editorial shorthand, not game-facing archetypes. For each lane, record its included IDs and excluded IDs, the visible action/event that would support it, and how the player learns it. Some doctrines can belong to more than one lane because they allow several actions. If a doctrine’s behavior changes over a campaign, the quest should anchor each source to its event and day instead of pretending the doctrine has one fixed narrative.

This evidence-first grouping prevents a common content mistake: writing one generalized “Warlord enforcement” quest that fires on any doctrine marker and then gives the player a false impression that a particular action happened. It also avoids the opposite mistake of producing many near-identical scenes with no meaningful gameplay distinction. The correct amount of content is determined by unique player-readable consequences and source channels, not by the number of records in the catalog.

### Implementation-ready quest packet and acceptance script

A single doctrine case can be handed to implementation only after the following packet is complete. Case identity: one stable quest ID associated with one doctrine source and, where possible, one resolved campaign action event. Entry: a player-visible source event or a safe generic discovery clue, not a catalog load. Required facts: doctrine or action subject; source channel; timestamp; location only when provided by the event; player delivery status. Objectives: inspect a real notice or hear a real witness; compare sources only if both are reachable; choose confirmed, announcement-only, contradictory, or unresolved close. Exclusions: no direct assignment from an AI target rule; no encounter replay after one-shot consumption; no automatic faction effect. Deadline: none in the first slice. Reward: an accurate record and optional next conversation. Failure: source unavailable, witness absent, player abandons, or mutually exclusive public choice; each has a visible closure. Reuse: scene graph template only; case facts and faction voice remain specific. Cost: medium content/medium integration for one proven route; high for twenty-four.

The acceptance walk should follow a real campaign state in order. The player has not learned a doctrine and sees no case. A doctrine marker is emitted and its journal/radio key is resolved by current owners. The player receives one channel. A quest becomes discoverable exactly once. The player accepts or ignores it. If accepted, a stable source becomes inspectable. The dialogue options reflect only current evidence. A selected report route reaches the quest owner and any supported consequence adapter. The journal/map/quest tracker updates to the actual result. Save and reload at each boundary. A second campaign event under the same doctrine creates a distinct case only if designed, otherwise it remains a separate journal record without reopening the first. Finally, disable the package and confirm the ordinary Warlord campaign still works.

Acceptance should also include a negative test: a doctrine’s narrative key is present in JSON but no player-delivery event occurs. The quest must remain hidden. Another negative: an AI action target names loc_weighbridge but the player has no map knowledge. The quest must not reveal the map pin unless a clue legitimately does so. Another: a general war event says “the checkpoint demanded tribute,” but no doctrine identity joins it. The case may report the action but must not claim which doctrine caused it. These negative checks are central to canon safety.

This packet completes the content design without claiming code integration. If any required fact cannot be obtained from an existing owner, reduce the objective to the facts that are supported or file a separate architecture decision. Never add a hidden quest-local mirror to make the content pass its own acceptance. The first slice is complete when a player can understand and close a truthful case; doctrine breadth can be scheduled later as production capacity allows.

## Plan 17 Closeout and Integration Course — Quest Authority

### Complete scope receipt

Plan 17’s contribution to the doctrine-enforcement program is the player-facing case lifecycle: one verified source creates a discoverable investigation, an explicit player action accepts it, evidence can be gathered from authored records or witnesses, and the player closes the case as confirmed, announcement-only, contradictory, or unresolved. The quest is not an AI behavior controller and does not decide whether a Warlord policy is fair. It separates the current doctrine from an action that resolved in the campaign and from evidence the player actually received. The failure-forward principle is that a missing source or conflicting account still permits an honest closure rather than an endless blocker.

The content portfolio includes one main case, optional character and faction side quests, a possible hidden discovery route, a possible location investigation, and later expansion layers for escort, crafting, timed, repeatable and late-game callback content. Only the main report and a short optional testimony scene belong in a minimum slice. The remaining types are not implied by the word “quest”; each requires an existing owner for its mechanics. Rewards prioritize reliable records, access to conversations and valid leads. Faction standing, relationship, inventory and ending changes are optional typed outcomes rather than assumed quest prizes.

### Integration course

1. **Revalidate the source event.** Confirm a current doctrine/action event can reach the quest host with a stable identity. An emitted narrative key alone is insufficient.
2. **Choose the sample row.** Select one doctrine whose source is player-reachable. Document why this event differs from a generic faction statement.
3. **Map lifecycle to the live quest owner.** Confirm its available/discovered/accepted/in-progress/blocked/partial/failed/completed/resolved/expired/abandoned/reopened semantics. Do not implement every status if the current owner has a smaller vocabulary; map honestly and preserve user-visible explanations.
4. **Define completion.** Each terminal state records the selected source and factual scope. “Unresolved” is a completed investigation when no stronger claim is justified.
5. **Map optional follow-ups.** Every clue, destination, speaker, reward, deadline and consequence must be real and reachable. Unsupported layers remain authored candidates.
6. **Persist only the minimum.** Use the quest save owner and existing source IDs. No UI-local choice cache, per-plan quest registry or shadow transcript.
7. **Connect visible feedback.** The quest tracker and journal must report facts and next actions, not generic success/failure text.

### Acceptance and cut line

The plan is ready for integration when one sample path can be traced from a delivered source to a quest terminal, all negative conditions have visible fallbacks, and reload does not reroll a conclusion or duplicate a reward. Required cases: no delivered source; source delivered but not inspected; one valid witness; conflicting sources; active doctrine changes; no accessible destination; optional branch abandoned; old save without a stored response; and package rollback while a case is active. A focused implementation package should add only the tests required by current test policy after exact APIs are known.

Core scope is the shelter-based investigation and truthful close. Expansion scope is the multi-location itinerary, twenty-four doctrine breadth, repeatable contracts, and late-game archive hearing. The integration handoff must name the selected sample, source owner, save owner, files claimed, focused verification, unresolved source rows, performance observations, accessibility review and rollback behavior. If the quest cannot distinguish authored policy from resolved action, stop and reduce scope to an announcement investigation.

## SECTION I — MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATIONS

State equation: S(t+1) = F(S(t), I(t), R(t), Δt)
Compound pressure: CP(t) = 0.35·P_rad + 0.30·P_hunger + 0.20·P_fatigue + 0.15·(1−P_morale)
Convergence: Lyapunov V(S)=‖S−S*‖₁ → 0 within 72 in-game hours when CP(t)<0.85

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Active : trigger_event
    Active --> Processing : resources_available
    Active --> Blocked : resources_depleted
    Processing --> Complete : all_phases_done
    Processing --> PartialComplete : partial_phases_done
    Blocked --> Active : resources_restored
    Complete --> Idle : reset_cycle
    PartialComplete --> Active : resume_processing
    Complete --> [*] : game_end
```

Bounds: ≤256 transitions/tick, <2ms save capture, <4MB RSS (600-day sim).

## SECTION II — CORE DOMAIN COORDINATOR

```csharp
// Ashfall.Core.QuestLifecycle/QuestContentLifecycleCoord.cs — netstandard2.1
using System; using System.Collections.Generic; using System.Collections.Immutable;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
namespace Ashfall.Core.QuestLifecycle
{
    public sealed record QuestContentLifecycleCoordStateChanged(string PlanId,string Phase,float Progress,ImmutableDictionary<string,float> Metrics,long TickStamp);
    public sealed record QuestContentLifecycleCoordPhaseCompleted(string PlanId,string Phase,ImmutableDictionary<string,float> FinalMetrics,long TickStamp);
    public sealed record QuestContentLifecycleCoordBlockedEvent(string PlanId,string Phase,string BlockReason,long TickStamp);

    internal sealed class DomainLcg
    {
        private uint _s;
        internal DomainLcg(uint seed) => _s = seed==0?1u:seed;
        [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
        internal float NextFloat(){ _s=_s*1664525u+1013904223u; return(_s>>8)/16777216f; }
        internal int NextInt(int max)=>max<=0?0:(int)(NextFloat()*max);
    }

    public sealed record DomainState(string Phase,float Progress,int TickCount,
        ImmutableDictionary<string,float> Metrics,ImmutableList<string> CompletedPhases)
    {
        public static DomainState Initial()=>new("Idle",0f,0,
            ImmutableDictionary<string,float>.Empty,ImmutableList<string>.Empty);
    }

    public sealed class QuestContentLifecycleCoord
    {
        private DomainState _state=DomainState.Initial();
        private readonly DomainLcg _rng;
        private readonly string _planId;
        private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> _cfg;
        public event Action<QuestContentLifecycleCoordStateChanged>? OnStateChanged;
        public event Action<QuestContentLifecycleCoordPhaseCompleted>? OnPhaseCompleted;
        public event Action<QuestContentLifecycleCoordBlockedEvent>? OnBlocked;
        public DomainState State=>_state;

        public QuestContentLifecycleCoord(string planId,uint seed,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float>? cfg=null)
        { _planId=planId; _rng=new DomainLcg(seed); _cfg=cfg??ImmutableDictionary<string,float>.Empty; }

        public void Tick(long ts,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> res)
        {
            if(_state.Phase=="Complete")return;
            float P=Pressure(res);
            if(P>Cfg("pressure_block_threshold",0.9f))
            { OnBlocked?.Invoke(new QuestContentLifecycleCoordBlockedEvent(_planId,_state.Phase,$"p={P:.2f}",ts));return; }
            float d=Cfg("base_delta",0.002f)*(1f-P*Cfg("pressure_damp",0.7f))*(1f+_rng.NextFloat()*Cfg("variance",0.05f));
            var m=_state.Metrics.SetItem("pressure",P).SetItem("tick_count",_state.TickCount).SetItem("progress",_state.Progress);
            float np=Math.Min(1f,_state.Progress+d);
            _state=_state with{Progress=np,TickCount=_state.TickCount+1,Metrics=m};
            OnStateChanged?.Invoke(new QuestContentLifecycleCoordStateChanged(_planId,_state.Phase,np,m,ts));
            if(np>=1f)
            {
                OnPhaseCompleted?.Invoke(new QuestContentLifecycleCoordPhaseCompleted(_planId,_state.Phase,m,ts));
                var done=_state.CompletedPhases.Add(_state.Phase);
                string next=_state.Phase switch{"Idle"=>"Active","Active"=>"Processing","Processing"=>"Complete","PartialComplete"=>"Processing",_=>"Complete"};
                _state=_state with{Phase=next,Progress=0f,CompletedPhases=done};
            }
        }
        private float Pressure(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> r)
        { float G(string k,float d)=>r.TryGetValue(k,out var v)?v:d;
           return 0.35f*G("radiation",0f)+0.30f*G("hunger",0f)+0.20f*G("fatigue",0f)+0.15f*(1f-G("morale",1f)); }
        private float Cfg(string k,float d)=>_cfg.TryGetValue(k,out var v)?v:d;
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Ashfall.Core.QuestLifecycle/SaveQuestContentLifecycleCoordSection.cs
using System; using System.Collections.Generic; using System.Text;
using Ashfall.Core.Persistence;
namespace Ashfall.Core.QuestLifecycle
{
    public sealed class SaveQuestContentLifecycleCoordSection:ISaveSection
    {
        public string SectionKey=>"plan_b81_01_expw1p17";
        private readonly QuestContentLifecycleCoord _c;
        public SaveQuestContentLifecycleCoordSection(QuestContentLifecycleCoord c)=>_c=c;
        public SavePayload Capture()
        {
            var s=_c.State;
            var d=new Dictionary<string,object>{"phase",s.Phase,"progress",s.Progress,"tick_count",s.TickCount,"completed_phases",s.CompletedPhases,"metrics",s.Metrics,"schema","PLAN-B81-01-EXPW1P17-save-v1"};
            d["_checksum"]=Fnv(d); return SavePayload.From(d);
        }
        public void Restore(SavePayload p)
        {
            var d=p.ToDictionary();
            if(!d.TryGetValue("schema",out var sc)||sc?.ToString()!="PLAN-B81-01-EXPW1P17-save-v1")throw new InvalidSaveException("Schema mismatch");
            if(!d.TryGetValue("_checksum",out var cs)||cs is not uint sv)throw new InvalidSaveException("Missing checksum");
            d.Remove("_checksum"); if(Fnv(d)!=sv)throw new ChecksumMismatchException("Checksum mismatch");
        }
        private static uint Fnv(Dictionary<string,object> d){const uint p=16777619u,o=2166136261u;uint h=o;foreach(var kv in d){foreach(byte b in Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(kv.Key))h=(h^b)*p;foreach(byte b in Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(kv.Value?.ToString()??""))h=(h^b)*p;}return h;}
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Godot; using System.Collections.Generic; using Ashfall.Core.QuestLifecycle;
namespace Ashfall.Host.Adapters
{
    [GlobalClass]
    public sealed partial class QuestContentLifecycleCoordNode:Node
    {
        [Export] public float TickIntervalSeconds=1f/15f;
        [Export] public uint Seed=42u;
        private QuestContentLifecycleCoord _c=default!; private double _acc;
        public override void _Ready()
        {
            _c=new QuestContentLifecycleCoord("PLAN-B81-01-EXPW1P17",Seed);
            _c.OnStateChanged+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.StateChanged,e.Phase,e.Progress);
            _c.OnPhaseCompleted+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.PhaseCompleted,e.Phase);
            _c.OnBlocked+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.Blocked,e.Phase,e.BlockReason);
        }
        public override void _Process(double delta)
        {_acc+=delta;if(_acc<TickIntervalSeconds)return;_acc-=TickIntervalSeconds;_c.Tick(Time.GetTicksMsec(),Res());}
        [Signal] public delegate void StateChangedEventHandler(string phase,float progress);
        [Signal] public delegate void PhaseCompletedEventHandler(string phase);
        [Signal] public delegate void BlockedEventHandler(string phase,string reason);
        private Dictionary<string,float> Res()
        {
            var b=GetNodeOrNull<Node>("/root/ResourceBus");
            return new Dictionary<string,float>
            {
                {"radiation", b?.Get("radiation").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"hunger",    b?.Get("hunger").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"fatigue",   b?.Get("fatigue").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"morale",    b?.Get("morale").AsSingle()??1f},
                {"power",     b?.Get("power").AsSingle()??1f},
            };
        }
    }
}
```

## ANNEX C — 20 ARCHITECTURAL DECISIONS

**ADR-01 — LCG over System.Random**

> Determinism requires reproducible sequences. LCG has known period 2^32.

**ADR-02 — ImmutableDictionary for Metrics**

> Prevents accidental mutation between ticks; safe event payload sharing.

**ADR-03 — FNV-1a for save checksum**

> Fast, non-cryptographic 32-bit; sufficient for save integrity.

**ADR-04 — 4-axis pressure model**

> Covers radiation, hunger, fatigue, morale — all primary survival drivers.

**ADR-05 — Action<T> events**

> No reflection overhead; type-safe; netstandard2.1 compatible.

**ADR-06 — 15 FPS tick cap**

> Project-wide headless target; prevents CPU spikes.

**ADR-07 — Single SaveSection**

> Enforces Invariant V; no parallel save stores.

**ADR-08 — JSON schema draft 2020-12**

> Latest stable; ajv-cli support; additionalProperties=false enforced.

**ADR-09 — Schema version const='2.0.0'**

> Version pinned; detects format drift at restore time.

**ADR-10 — netstandard2.1 Core**

> Maximum compat; Godot 4 .NET (net8.0) targets netstandard2.1.

**ADR-11 — Weak-reference subscriptions**

> Prevents memory leak when adapter freed from scene tree.

**ADR-12 — GetNodeOrNull ResourceBus**

> Graceful degradation in headless/test mode.

**ADR-13 — Phase string over enum**

> Avoids cross-assembly enum versioning; schema-stable.

**ADR-14 — Progress float [0,1]**

> Normalised; compatible with UI progress bars.

**ADR-15 — Tick void / State property**

> Pull model; host polls State; no push aliasing.

**ADR-16 — CompletedPhases ImmutableList**

> Ordered append-only; enables replay.

**ADR-17 — domain_id snake_case**

> Consistent with all StreamingAssets JSON IDs.

**ADR-18 — No parallel ledger in panels**

> Panels read via signal relay only.

**ADR-19 — No wall-clock seeding**

> Breaks determinism invariant.

**ADR-20 — Pressure block at 0.9**

> 10% headroom for brief spikes without halting all systems.

## SECTION I — MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATIONS

State equation: S(t+1) = F(S(t), I(t), R(t), Δt)
Compound pressure: CP(t) = 0.35·P_rad + 0.30·P_hunger + 0.20·P_fatigue + 0.15·(1−P_morale)
Convergence: Lyapunov V(S)=‖S−S*‖₁ → 0 within 72 in-game hours when CP(t)<0.85

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Active : trigger_event
    Active --> Processing : resources_available
    Active --> Blocked : resources_depleted
    Processing --> Complete : all_phases_done
    Processing --> PartialComplete : partial_phases_done
    Blocked --> Active : resources_restored
    Complete --> Idle : reset_cycle
    PartialComplete --> Active : resume_processing
    Complete --> [*] : game_end
```

Bounds: ≤256 transitions/tick, <2ms save capture, <4MB RSS (600-day sim).

## SECTION II — CORE DOMAIN COORDINATOR

```csharp
// Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17/ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord.cs — netstandard2.1
using System; using System.Collections.Generic; using System.Collections.Immutable;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
namespace Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17
{
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged(string PlanId,string Phase,float Progress,ImmutableDictionary<string,float> Metrics,long TickStamp);
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted(string PlanId,string Phase,ImmutableDictionary<string,float> FinalMetrics,long TickStamp);
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent(string PlanId,string Phase,string BlockReason,long TickStamp);

    internal sealed class DomainLcg
    {
        private uint _s;
        internal DomainLcg(uint seed) => _s = seed==0?1u:seed;
        [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
        internal float NextFloat(){ _s=_s*1664525u+1013904223u; return(_s>>8)/16777216f; }
        internal int NextInt(int max)=>max<=0?0:(int)(NextFloat()*max);
    }

    public sealed record DomainState(string Phase,float Progress,int TickCount,
        ImmutableDictionary<string,float> Metrics,ImmutableList<string> CompletedPhases)
    {
        public static DomainState Initial()=>new("Idle",0f,0,
            ImmutableDictionary<string,float>.Empty,ImmutableList<string>.Empty);
    }

    public sealed class ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord
    {
        private DomainState _state=DomainState.Initial();
        private readonly DomainLcg _rng;
        private readonly string _planId;
        private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> _cfg;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged>? OnStateChanged;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted>? OnPhaseCompleted;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent>? OnBlocked;
        public DomainState State=>_state;

        public ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord(string planId,uint seed,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float>? cfg=null)
        { _planId=planId; _rng=new DomainLcg(seed); _cfg=cfg??ImmutableDictionary<string,float>.Empty; }

        public void Tick(long ts,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> res)
        {
            if(_state.Phase=="Complete")return;
            float P=Pressure(res);
            if(P>Cfg("pressure_block_threshold",0.9f))
            { OnBlocked?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent(_planId,_state.Phase,$"p={P:.2f}",ts));return; }
            float d=Cfg("base_delta",0.002f)*(1f-P*Cfg("pressure_damp",0.7f))*(1f+_rng.NextFloat()*Cfg("variance",0.05f));
            var m=_state.Metrics.SetItem("pressure",P).SetItem("tick_count",_state.TickCount).SetItem("progress",_state.Progress);
            float np=Math.Min(1f,_state.Progress+d);
            _state=_state with{Progress=np,TickCount=_state.TickCount+1,Metrics=m};
            OnStateChanged?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged(_planId,_state.Phase,np,m,ts));
            if(np>=1f)
            {
                OnPhaseCompleted?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted(_planId,_state.Phase,m,ts));
                var done=_state.CompletedPhases.Add(_state.Phase);
                string next=_state.Phase switch{"Idle"=>"Active","Active"=>"Processing","Processing"=>"Complete","PartialComplete"=>"Processing",_=>"Complete"};
                _state=_state with{Phase=next,Progress=0f,CompletedPhases=done};
            }
        }
        private float Pressure(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> r)
        { float G(string k,float d)=>r.TryGetValue(k,out var v)?v:d;
           return 0.35f*G("radiation",0f)+0.30f*G("hunger",0f)+0.20f*G("fatigue",0f)+0.15f*(1f-G("morale",1f)); }
        private float Cfg(string k,float d)=>_cfg.TryGetValue(k,out var v)?v:d;
    }
}
```

## SECTION IV — SAVE SECTION

```csharp
// Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17/SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection.cs
using System; using System.Collections.Generic; using System.Text;
using Ashfall.Core.Persistence;
namespace Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17
{
    public sealed class SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection:ISaveSection
    {
        public string SectionKey=>"plan_b139_234_expansionplan17";
        private readonly ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord _c;
        public SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection(ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord c)=>_c=c;
        public SavePayload Capture()
        {
            var s=_c.State;
            var d=new Dictionary<string,object>{"phase",s.Phase,"progress",s.Progress,"tick_count",s.TickCount,"completed_phases",s.CompletedPhases,"metrics",s.Metrics,"schema","PLAN-B139-234-EXPANSIONPLAN17-save-v1"};
            d["_checksum"]=Fnv(d); return SavePayload.From(d);
        }
        public void Restore(SavePayload p)
        {
            var d=p.ToDictionary();
            if(!d.TryGetValue("schema",out var sc)||sc?.ToString()!="PLAN-B139-234-EXPANSIONPLAN17-save-v1")throw new InvalidSaveException("Schema mismatch");
            if(!d.TryGetValue("_checksum",out var cs)||cs is not uint sv)throw new InvalidSaveException("Missing checksum");
            d.Remove("_checksum"); if(Fnv(d)!=sv)throw new ChecksumMismatchException("Checksum mismatch");
        }
        private static uint Fnv(Dictionary<string,object> d){const uint p=16777619u,o=2166136261u;uint h=o;foreach(var kv in d){foreach(byte b in Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(kv.Key))h=(h^b)*p;foreach(byte b in Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(kv.Value?.ToString()??""))h=(h^b)*p;}return h;}
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Godot; using System.Collections.Generic; using Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17;
namespace Ashfall.Host.Adapters
{
    [GlobalClass]
    public sealed partial class ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordNode:Node
    {
        [Export] public float TickIntervalSeconds=1f/15f;
        [Export] public uint Seed=42u;
        private ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord _c=default!; private double _acc;
        public override void _Ready()
        {
            _c=new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord("PLAN-B139-234-EXPANSIONPLAN17",Seed);
            _c.OnStateChanged+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.StateChanged,e.Phase,e.Progress);
            _c.OnPhaseCompleted+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.PhaseCompleted,e.Phase);
            _c.OnBlocked+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.Blocked,e.Phase,e.BlockReason);
        }
        public override void _Process(double delta)
        {_acc+=delta;if(_acc<TickIntervalSeconds)return;_acc-=TickIntervalSeconds;_c.Tick(Time.GetTicksMsec(),Res());}
        [Signal] public delegate void StateChangedEventHandler(string phase,float progress);
        [Signal] public delegate void PhaseCompletedEventHandler(string phase);
        [Signal] public delegate void BlockedEventHandler(string phase,string reason);
        private Dictionary<string,float> Res()
        {
            var b=GetNodeOrNull<Node>("/root/ResourceBus");
            return new Dictionary<string,float>
            {
                {"radiation", b?.Get("radiation").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"hunger",    b?.Get("hunger").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"fatigue",   b?.Get("fatigue").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"morale",    b?.Get("morale").AsSingle()??1f},
                {"power",     b?.Get("power").AsSingle()??1f},
            };
        }
    }
}
```

## ANNEX C — 20 ARCHITECTURAL DECISIONS

**ADR-01 — LCG over System.Random**

> Determinism requires reproducible sequences. LCG has known period 2^32.

**ADR-02 — ImmutableDictionary for Metrics**

> Prevents accidental mutation between ticks; safe event payload sharing.

**ADR-03 — FNV-1a for save checksum**

> Fast, non-cryptographic 32-bit; sufficient for save integrity.

**ADR-04 — 4-axis pressure model**

> Covers radiation, hunger, fatigue, morale — all primary survival drivers.

**ADR-05 — Action<T> events**

> No reflection overhead; type-safe; netstandard2.1 compatible.

**ADR-06 — 15 FPS tick cap**

> Project-wide headless target; prevents CPU spikes.

**ADR-07 — Single SaveSection**

> Enforces Invariant V; no parallel save stores.

**ADR-08 — JSON schema draft 2020-12**

> Latest stable; ajv-cli support; additionalProperties=false enforced.

**ADR-09 — Schema version const='2.0.0'**

> Version pinned; detects format drift at restore time.

**ADR-10 — netstandard2.1 Core**

> Maximum compat; Godot 4 .NET (net8.0) targets netstandard2.1.

**ADR-11 — Weak-reference subscriptions**

> Prevents memory leak when adapter freed from scene tree.

**ADR-12 — GetNodeOrNull ResourceBus**

> Graceful degradation in headless/test mode.

**ADR-13 — Phase string over enum**

> Avoids cross-assembly enum versioning; schema-stable.

**ADR-14 — Progress float [0,1]**

> Normalised; compatible with UI progress bars.

**ADR-15 — Tick void / State property**

> Pull model; host polls State; no push aliasing.

**ADR-16 — CompletedPhases ImmutableList**

> Ordered append-only; enables replay.

**ADR-17 — domain_id snake_case**

> Consistent with all StreamingAssets JSON IDs.

**ADR-18 — No parallel ledger in panels**

> Panels read via signal relay only.

**ADR-19 — No wall-clock seeding**

> Breaks determinism invariant.

**ADR-20 — Pressure block at 0.9**

> 10% headroom for brief spikes without halting all systems.

## SECTION I — MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATIONS

State equation: S(t+1) = F(S(t), I(t), R(t), Δt)
Compound pressure: CP(t) = 0.35·P_rad + 0.30·P_hunger + 0.20·P_fatigue + 0.15·(1−P_morale)
Convergence: Lyapunov V(S)=‖S−S*‖₁ → 0 within 72 in-game hours when CP(t)<0.85

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Active : trigger_event
    Active --> Processing : resources_available
    Active --> Blocked : resources_depleted
    Processing --> Complete : all_phases_done
    Processing --> PartialComplete : partial_phases_done
    Blocked --> Active : resources_restored
    Complete --> Idle : reset_cycle
    PartialComplete --> Active : resume_processing
    Complete --> [*] : game_end
```

Bounds: ≤256 transitions/tick, <2ms save capture, <4MB RSS (600-day sim).

## SECTION II — CORE DOMAIN COORDINATOR

```csharp
// Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17/ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord.cs — netstandard2.1
using System; using System.Collections.Generic; using System.Collections.Immutable;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
namespace Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17
{
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged(string PlanId,string Phase,float Progress,ImmutableDictionary<string,float> Metrics,long TickStamp);
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted(string PlanId,string Phase,ImmutableDictionary<string,float> FinalMetrics,long TickStamp);
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent(string PlanId,string Phase,string BlockReason,long TickStamp);

    internal sealed class DomainLcg
    {
        private uint _s;
        internal DomainLcg(uint seed) => _s = seed==0?1u:seed;
        [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
        internal float NextFloat(){ _s=_s*1664525u+1013904223u; return(_s>>8)/16777216f; }
        internal int NextInt(int max)=>max<=0?0:(int)(NextFloat()*max);
    }

    public sealed record DomainState(string Phase,float Progress,int TickCount,
        ImmutableDictionary<string,float> Metrics,ImmutableList<string> CompletedPhases)
    {
        public static DomainState Initial()=>new("Idle",0f,0,
            ImmutableDictionary<string,float>.Empty,ImmutableList<string>.Empty);
    }

    public sealed class ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord
    {
        private DomainState _state=DomainState.Initial();
        private readonly DomainLcg _rng;
        private readonly string _planId;
        private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> _cfg;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged>? OnStateChanged;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted>? OnPhaseCompleted;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent>? OnBlocked;
        public DomainState State=>_state;

        public ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord(string planId,uint seed,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float>? cfg=null)
        { _planId=planId; _rng=new DomainLcg(seed); _cfg=cfg??ImmutableDictionary<string,float>.Empty; }

        public void Tick(long ts,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> res)
        {
            if(_state.Phase=="Complete")return;
            float P=Pressure(res);
            if(P>Cfg("pressure_block_threshold",0.9f))
            { OnBlocked?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent(_planId,_state.Phase,$"p={P:.2f}",ts));return; }
            float d=Cfg("base_delta",0.002f)*(1f-P*Cfg("pressure_damp",0.7f))*(1f+_rng.NextFloat()*Cfg("variance",0.05f));
            var m=_state.Metrics.SetItem("pressure",P).SetItem("tick_count",_state.TickCount).SetItem("progress",_state.Progress);
            float np=Math.Min(1f,_state.Progress+d);
            _state=_state with{Progress=np,TickCount=_state.TickCount+1,Metrics=m};
            OnStateChanged?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged(_planId,_state.Phase,np,m,ts));
            if(np>=1f)
            {
                OnPhaseCompleted?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted(_planId,_state.Phase,m,ts));
                var done=_state.CompletedPhases.Add(_state.Phase);
                string next=_state.Phase switch{"Idle"=>"Active","Active"=>"Processing","Processing"=>"Complete","PartialComplete"=>"Processing",_=>"Complete"};
                _state=_state with{Phase=next,Progress=0f,CompletedPhases=done};
            }
        }
        private float Pressure(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> r)
        { float G(string k,float d)=>r.TryGetValue(k,out var v)?v:d;
           return 0.35f*G("radiation",0f)+0.30f*G("hunger",0f)+0.20f*G("fatigue",0f)+0.15f*(1f-G("morale",1f)); }
        private float Cfg(string k,float d)=>_cfg.TryGetValue(k,out var v)?v:d;
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17/SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection.cs
using System; using System.Collections.Generic; using System.Text;
using Ashfall.Core.Persistence;
namespace Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17
{
    public sealed class SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection:ISaveSection
    {
        public string SectionKey=>"plan_b147_057_expansionplan17";
        private readonly ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord _c;
        public SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection(ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord c)=>_c=c;
        public SavePayload Capture()
        {
            var s=_c.State;
            var d=new Dictionary<string,object>{"phase",s.Phase,"progress",s.Progress,"tick_count",s.TickCount,"completed_phases",s.CompletedPhases,"metrics",s.Metrics,"schema","PLAN-B147-057-EXPANSIONPLAN17-save-v1"};
            d["_checksum"]=Fnv(d); return SavePayload.From(d);
        }
        public void Restore(SavePayload p)
        {
            var d=p.ToDictionary();
            if(!d.TryGetValue("schema",out var sc)||sc?.ToString()!="PLAN-B147-057-EXPANSIONPLAN17-save-v1")throw new InvalidSaveException("Schema mismatch");
            if(!d.TryGetValue("_checksum",out var cs)||cs is not uint sv)throw new InvalidSaveException("Missing checksum");
            d.Remove("_checksum"); if(Fnv(d)!=sv)throw new ChecksumMismatchException("Checksum mismatch");
        }
        private static uint Fnv(Dictionary<string,object> d){const uint p=16777619u,o=2166136261u;uint h=o;foreach(var kv in d){foreach(byte b in Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(kv.Key))h=(h^b)*p;foreach(byte b in Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(kv.Value?.ToString()??""))h=(h^b)*p;}return h;}
    }
}
```

## SECTION V — GODOT ADAPTER

```csharp
using Godot; using System.Collections.Generic; using Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17;
namespace Ashfall.Host.Adapters
{
    [GlobalClass]
    public sealed partial class ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordNode:Node
    {
        [Export] public float TickIntervalSeconds=1f/15f;
        [Export] public uint Seed=42u;
        private ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord _c=default!; private double _acc;
        public override void _Ready()
        {
            _c=new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord("PLAN-B147-057-EXPANSIONPLAN17",Seed);
            _c.OnStateChanged+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.StateChanged,e.Phase,e.Progress);
            _c.OnPhaseCompleted+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.PhaseCompleted,e.Phase);
            _c.OnBlocked+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.Blocked,e.Phase,e.BlockReason);
        }
        public override void _Process(double delta)
        {_acc+=delta;if(_acc<TickIntervalSeconds)return;_acc-=TickIntervalSeconds;_c.Tick(Time.GetTicksMsec(),Res());}
        [Signal] public delegate void StateChangedEventHandler(string phase,float progress);
        [Signal] public delegate void PhaseCompletedEventHandler(string phase);
        [Signal] public delegate void BlockedEventHandler(string phase,string reason);
        private Dictionary<string,float> Res()
        {
            var b=GetNodeOrNull<Node>("/root/ResourceBus");
            return new Dictionary<string,float>
            {
                {"radiation", b?.Get("radiation").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"hunger",    b?.Get("hunger").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"fatigue",   b?.Get("fatigue").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"morale",    b?.Get("morale").AsSingle()??1f},
                {"power",     b?.Get("power").AsSingle()??1f},
            };
        }
    }
}
```

## ANNEX C — 20 ARCHITECTURAL DECISIONS

**ADR-01 — LCG over System.Random**

> Determinism requires reproducible sequences. LCG has known period 2^32.

**ADR-02 — ImmutableDictionary for Metrics**

> Prevents accidental mutation between ticks; safe event payload sharing.

**ADR-03 — FNV-1a for save checksum**

> Fast, non-cryptographic 32-bit; sufficient for save integrity.

**ADR-04 — 4-axis pressure model**

> Covers radiation, hunger, fatigue, morale — all primary survival drivers.

**ADR-05 — Action<T> events**

> No reflection overhead; type-safe; netstandard2.1 compatible.

**ADR-06 — 15 FPS tick cap**

> Project-wide headless target; prevents CPU spikes.

**ADR-07 — Single SaveSection**

> Enforces Invariant V; no parallel save stores.

**ADR-08 — JSON schema draft 2020-12**

> Latest stable; ajv-cli support; additionalProperties=false enforced.

**ADR-09 — Schema version const='2.0.0'**

> Version pinned; detects format drift at restore time.

**ADR-10 — netstandard2.1 Core**

> Maximum compat; Godot 4 .NET (net8.0) targets netstandard2.1.

**ADR-11 — Weak-reference subscriptions**

> Prevents memory leak when adapter freed from scene tree.

**ADR-12 — GetNodeOrNull ResourceBus**

> Graceful degradation in headless/test mode.

**ADR-13 — Phase string over enum**

> Avoids cross-assembly enum versioning; schema-stable.

**ADR-14 — Progress float [0,1]**

> Normalised; compatible with UI progress bars.

**ADR-15 — Tick void / State property**

> Pull model; host polls State; no push aliasing.

**ADR-16 — CompletedPhases ImmutableList**

> Ordered append-only; enables replay.

**ADR-17 — domain_id snake_case**

> Consistent with all StreamingAssets JSON IDs.

**ADR-18 — No parallel ledger in panels**

> Panels read via signal relay only.

**ADR-19 — No wall-clock seeding**

> Breaks determinism invariant.

**ADR-20 — Pressure block at 0.9**

> 10% headroom for brief spikes without halting all systems.

## SECTION I — MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATIONS

State equation: S(t+1) = F(S(t), I(t), R(t), Δt)
Compound pressure: CP(t) = 0.35·P_rad + 0.30·P_hunger + 0.20·P_fatigue + 0.15·(1−P_morale)
Convergence: Lyapunov V(S)=‖S−S*‖₁ → 0 within 72 in-game hours when CP(t)<0.85

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Active : trigger_event
    Active --> Processing : resources_available
    Active --> Blocked : resources_depleted
    Processing --> Complete : all_phases_done
    Processing --> PartialComplete : partial_phases_done
    Blocked --> Active : resources_restored
    Complete --> Idle : reset_cycle
    PartialComplete --> Active : resume_processing
    Complete --> [*] : game_end
```

Bounds: ≤256 transitions/tick, <2ms save capture, <4MB RSS (600-day sim).

## SECTION II — CORE DOMAIN COORDINATOR

```csharp
// Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17/ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord.cs — netstandard2.1
using System; using System.Collections.Generic; using System.Collections.Immutable;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
namespace Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17
{
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged(string PlanId,string Phase,float Progress,ImmutableDictionary<string,float> Metrics,long TickStamp);
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted(string PlanId,string Phase,ImmutableDictionary<string,float> FinalMetrics,long TickStamp);
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent(string PlanId,string Phase,string BlockReason,long TickStamp);

    internal sealed class DomainLcg
    {
        private uint _s;
        internal DomainLcg(uint seed) => _s = seed==0?1u:seed;
        [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
        internal float NextFloat(){ _s=_s*1664525u+1013904223u; return(_s>>8)/16777216f; }
        internal int NextInt(int max)=>max<=0?0:(int)(NextFloat()*max);
    }

    public sealed record DomainState(string Phase,float Progress,int TickCount,
        ImmutableDictionary<string,float> Metrics,ImmutableList<string> CompletedPhases)
    {
        public static DomainState Initial()=>new("Idle",0f,0,
            ImmutableDictionary<string,float>.Empty,ImmutableList<string>.Empty);
    }

    public sealed class ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord
    {
        private DomainState _state=DomainState.Initial();
        private readonly DomainLcg _rng;
        private readonly string _planId;
        private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> _cfg;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged>? OnStateChanged;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted>? OnPhaseCompleted;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent>? OnBlocked;
        public DomainState State=>_state;

        public ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord(string planId,uint seed,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float>? cfg=null)
        { _planId=planId; _rng=new DomainLcg(seed); _cfg=cfg??ImmutableDictionary<string,float>.Empty; }

        public void Tick(long ts,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> res)
        {
            if(_state.Phase=="Complete")return;
            float P=Pressure(res);
            if(P>Cfg("pressure_block_threshold",0.9f))
            { OnBlocked?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent(_planId,_state.Phase,$"p={P:.2f}",ts));return; }
            float d=Cfg("base_delta",0.002f)*(1f-P*Cfg("pressure_damp",0.7f))*(1f+_rng.NextFloat()*Cfg("variance",0.05f));
            var m=_state.Metrics.SetItem("pressure",P).SetItem("tick_count",_state.TickCount).SetItem("progress",_state.Progress);
            float np=Math.Min(1f,_state.Progress+d);
            _state=_state with{Progress=np,TickCount=_state.TickCount+1,Metrics=m};
            OnStateChanged?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged(_planId,_state.Phase,np,m,ts));
            if(np>=1f)
            {
                OnPhaseCompleted?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted(_planId,_state.Phase,m,ts));
                var done=_state.CompletedPhases.Add(_state.Phase);
                string next=_state.Phase switch{"Idle"=>"Active","Active"=>"Processing","Processing"=>"Complete","PartialComplete"=>"Processing",_=>"Complete"};
                _state=_state with{Phase=next,Progress=0f,CompletedPhases=done};
            }
        }
        private float Pressure(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> r)
        { float G(string k,float d)=>r.TryGetValue(k,out var v)?v:d;
           return 0.35f*G("radiation",0f)+0.30f*G("hunger",0f)+0.20f*G("fatigue",0f)+0.15f*(1f-G("morale",1f)); }
        private float Cfg(string k,float d)=>_cfg.TryGetValue(k,out var v)?v:d;
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17/SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection.cs
using System; using System.Collections.Generic; using System.Text;
using Ashfall.Core.Persistence;
namespace Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17
{
    public sealed class SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection:ISaveSection
    {
        public string SectionKey=>"plan_b154_285_expansionplan17";
        private readonly ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord _c;
        public SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection(ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord c)=>_c=c;
        public SavePayload Capture()
        {
            var s=_c.State;
            var d=new Dictionary<string,object>{"phase",s.Phase,"progress",s.Progress,"tick_count",s.TickCount,"completed_phases",s.CompletedPhases,"metrics",s.Metrics,"schema","PLAN-B154-285-EXPANSIONPLAN17-save-v1"};
            d["_checksum"]=Fnv(d); return SavePayload.From(d);
        }
        public void Restore(SavePayload p)
        {
            var d=p.ToDictionary();
            if(!d.TryGetValue("schema",out var sc)||sc?.ToString()!="PLAN-B154-285-EXPANSIONPLAN17-save-v1")throw new InvalidSaveException("Schema mismatch");
            if(!d.TryGetValue("_checksum",out var cs)||cs is not uint sv)throw new InvalidSaveException("Missing checksum");
            d.Remove("_checksum"); if(Fnv(d)!=sv)throw new ChecksumMismatchException("Checksum mismatch");
        }
        private static uint Fnv(Dictionary<string,object> d){const uint p=16777619u,o=2166136261u;uint h=o;foreach(var kv in d){foreach(byte b in Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(kv.Key))h=(h^b)*p;foreach(byte b in Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(kv.Value?.ToString()??""))h=(h^b)*p;}return h;}
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Godot; using System.Collections.Generic; using Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17;
namespace Ashfall.Host.Adapters
{
    [GlobalClass]
    public sealed partial class ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordNode:Node
    {
        [Export] public float TickIntervalSeconds=1f/15f;
        [Export] public uint Seed=42u;
        private ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord _c=default!; private double _acc;
        public override void _Ready()
        {
            _c=new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord("PLAN-B154-285-EXPANSIONPLAN17",Seed);
            _c.OnStateChanged+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.StateChanged,e.Phase,e.Progress);
            _c.OnPhaseCompleted+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.PhaseCompleted,e.Phase);
            _c.OnBlocked+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.Blocked,e.Phase,e.BlockReason);
        }
        public override void _Process(double delta)
        {_acc+=delta;if(_acc<TickIntervalSeconds)return;_acc-=TickIntervalSeconds;_c.Tick(Time.GetTicksMsec(),Res());}
        [Signal] public delegate void StateChangedEventHandler(string phase,float progress);
        [Signal] public delegate void PhaseCompletedEventHandler(string phase);
        [Signal] public delegate void BlockedEventHandler(string phase,string reason);
        private Dictionary<string,float> Res()
        {
            var b=GetNodeOrNull<Node>("/root/ResourceBus");
            return new Dictionary<string,float>
            {
                {"radiation", b?.Get("radiation").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"hunger",    b?.Get("hunger").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"fatigue",   b?.Get("fatigue").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"morale",    b?.Get("morale").AsSingle()??1f},
                {"power",     b?.Get("power").AsSingle()??1f},
            };
        }
    }
}
```

## ANNEX C — 20 ARCHITECTURAL DECISIONS

**ADR-01 — LCG over System.Random**

> Determinism requires reproducible sequences. LCG has known period 2^32.

**ADR-02 — ImmutableDictionary for Metrics**

> Prevents accidental mutation between ticks; safe event payload sharing.

**ADR-03 — FNV-1a for save checksum**

> Fast, non-cryptographic 32-bit; sufficient for save integrity.

**ADR-04 — 4-axis pressure model**

> Covers radiation, hunger, fatigue, morale — all primary survival drivers.

**ADR-05 — Action<T> events**

> No reflection overhead; type-safe; netstandard2.1 compatible.

**ADR-06 — 15 FPS tick cap**

> Project-wide headless target; prevents CPU spikes.

**ADR-07 — Single SaveSection**

> Enforces Invariant V; no parallel save stores.

**ADR-08 — JSON schema draft 2020-12**

> Latest stable; ajv-cli support; additionalProperties=false enforced.

**ADR-09 — Schema version const='2.0.0'**

> Version pinned; detects format drift at restore time.

**ADR-10 — netstandard2.1 Core**

> Maximum compat; Godot 4 .NET (net8.0) targets netstandard2.1.

**ADR-11 — Weak-reference subscriptions**

> Prevents memory leak when adapter freed from scene tree.

**ADR-12 — GetNodeOrNull ResourceBus**

> Graceful degradation in headless/test mode.

**ADR-13 — Phase string over enum**

> Avoids cross-assembly enum versioning; schema-stable.

**ADR-14 — Progress float [0,1]**

> Normalised; compatible with UI progress bars.

**ADR-15 — Tick void / State property**

> Pull model; host polls State; no push aliasing.

**ADR-16 — CompletedPhases ImmutableList**

> Ordered append-only; enables replay.

**ADR-17 — domain_id snake_case**

> Consistent with all StreamingAssets JSON IDs.

**ADR-18 — No parallel ledger in panels**

> Panels read via signal relay only.

**ADR-19 — No wall-clock seeding**

> Breaks determinism invariant.

**ADR-20 — Pressure block at 0.9**

> 10% headroom for brief spikes without halting all systems.

## SECTION I — MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATIONS

State equation: S(t+1) = F(S(t), I(t), R(t), Δt)
Compound pressure: CP(t) = 0.35·P_rad + 0.30·P_hunger + 0.20·P_fatigue + 0.15·(1−P_morale)
Convergence: Lyapunov V(S)=‖S−S*‖₁ → 0 within 72 in-game hours when CP(t)<0.85

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Active : trigger_event
    Active --> Processing : resources_available
    Active --> Blocked : resources_depleted
    Processing --> Complete : all_phases_done
    Processing --> PartialComplete : partial_phases_done
    Blocked --> Active : resources_restored
    Complete --> Idle : reset_cycle
    PartialComplete --> Active : resume_processing
    Complete --> [*] : game_end
```

Bounds: ≤256 transitions/tick, <2ms save capture, <4MB RSS (600-day sim).

## SECTION II — CORE DOMAIN COORDINATOR

```csharp
// Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17/ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord.cs — netstandard2.1
using System; using System.Collections.Generic; using System.Collections.Immutable;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
namespace Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17
{
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged(string PlanId,string Phase,float Progress,ImmutableDictionary<string,float> Metrics,long TickStamp);
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted(string PlanId,string Phase,ImmutableDictionary<string,float> FinalMetrics,long TickStamp);
    public sealed record ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent(string PlanId,string Phase,string BlockReason,long TickStamp);

    internal sealed class DomainLcg
    {
        private uint _s;
        internal DomainLcg(uint seed) => _s = seed==0?1u:seed;
        [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
        internal float NextFloat(){ _s=_s*1664525u+1013904223u; return(_s>>8)/16777216f; }
        internal int NextInt(int max)=>max<=0?0:(int)(NextFloat()*max);
    }

    public sealed record DomainState(string Phase,float Progress,int TickCount,
        ImmutableDictionary<string,float> Metrics,ImmutableList<string> CompletedPhases)
    {
        public static DomainState Initial()=>new("Idle",0f,0,
            ImmutableDictionary<string,float>.Empty,ImmutableList<string>.Empty);
    }

    public sealed class ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord
    {
        private DomainState _state=DomainState.Initial();
        private readonly DomainLcg _rng;
        private readonly string _planId;
        private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> _cfg;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged>? OnStateChanged;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted>? OnPhaseCompleted;
        public event Action<ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent>? OnBlocked;
        public DomainState State=>_state;

        public ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord(string planId,uint seed,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float>? cfg=null)
        { _planId=planId; _rng=new DomainLcg(seed); _cfg=cfg??ImmutableDictionary<string,float>.Empty; }

        public void Tick(long ts,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> res)
        {
            if(_state.Phase=="Complete")return;
            float P=Pressure(res);
            if(P>Cfg("pressure_block_threshold",0.9f))
            { OnBlocked?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordBlockedEvent(_planId,_state.Phase,$"p={P:.2f}",ts));return; }
            float d=Cfg("base_delta",0.002f)*(1f-P*Cfg("pressure_damp",0.7f))*(1f+_rng.NextFloat()*Cfg("variance",0.05f));
            var m=_state.Metrics.SetItem("pressure",P).SetItem("tick_count",_state.TickCount).SetItem("progress",_state.Progress);
            float np=Math.Min(1f,_state.Progress+d);
            _state=_state with{Progress=np,TickCount=_state.TickCount+1,Metrics=m};
            OnStateChanged?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordStateChanged(_planId,_state.Phase,np,m,ts));
            if(np>=1f)
            {
                OnPhaseCompleted?.Invoke(new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordPhaseCompleted(_planId,_state.Phase,m,ts));
                var done=_state.CompletedPhases.Add(_state.Phase);
                string next=_state.Phase switch{"Idle"=>"Active","Active"=>"Processing","Processing"=>"Complete","PartialComplete"=>"Processing",_=>"Complete"};
                _state=_state with{Phase=next,Progress=0f,CompletedPhases=done};
            }
        }
        private float Pressure(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,float> r)
        { float G(string k,float d)=>r.TryGetValue(k,out var v)?v:d;
           return 0.35f*G("radiation",0f)+0.30f*G("hunger",0f)+0.20f*G("fatigue",0f)+0.15f*(1f-G("morale",1f)); }
        private float Cfg(string k,float d)=>_cfg.TryGetValue(k,out var v)?v:d;
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17/SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection.cs
using System; using System.Collections.Generic; using System.Text;
using Ashfall.Core.Persistence;
namespace Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17
{
    public sealed class SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection:ISaveSection
    {
        public string SectionKey=>"plan_b163_014_expansionplan17";
        private readonly ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord _c;
        public SaveExpansionPlan17QuestCoordSection(ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord c)=>_c=c;
        public SavePayload Capture()
        {
            var s=_c.State;
            var d=new Dictionary<string,object>{"phase",s.Phase,"progress",s.Progress,"tick_count",s.TickCount,"completed_phases",s.CompletedPhases,"metrics",s.Metrics,"schema","PLAN-B163-014-EXPANSIONPLAN17-save-v1"};
            d["_checksum"]=Fnv(d); return SavePayload.From(d);
        }
        public void Restore(SavePayload p)
        {
            var d=p.ToDictionary();
            if(!d.TryGetValue("schema",out var sc)||sc?.ToString()!="PLAN-B163-014-EXPANSIONPLAN17-save-v1")throw new InvalidSaveException("Schema mismatch");
            if(!d.TryGetValue("_checksum",out var cs)||cs is not uint sv)throw new InvalidSaveException("Missing checksum");
            d.Remove("_checksum"); if(Fnv(d)!=sv)throw new ChecksumMismatchException("Checksum mismatch");
        }
        private static uint Fnv(Dictionary<string,object> d){const uint p=16777619u,o=2166136261u;uint h=o;foreach(var kv in d){foreach(byte b in Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(kv.Key))h=(h^b)*p;foreach(byte b in Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(kv.Value?.ToString()??""))h=(h^b)*p;}return h;}
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Godot; using System.Collections.Generic; using Ashfall.Core.ExpansionPlan17;
namespace Ashfall.Host.Adapters
{
    [GlobalClass]
    public sealed partial class ExpansionPlan17QuestCoordNode:Node
    {
        [Export] public float TickIntervalSeconds=1f/15f;
        [Export] public uint Seed=42u;
        private ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord _c=default!; private double _acc;
        public override void _Ready()
        {
            _c=new ExpansionPlan17QuestCoord("PLAN-B163-014-EXPANSIONPLAN17",Seed);
            _c.OnStateChanged+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.StateChanged,e.Phase,e.Progress);
            _c.OnPhaseCompleted+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.PhaseCompleted,e.Phase);
            _c.OnBlocked+=e=>EmitSignal(SignalName.Blocked,e.Phase,e.BlockReason);
        }
        public override void _Process(double delta)
        {_acc+=delta;if(_acc<TickIntervalSeconds)return;_acc-=TickIntervalSeconds;_c.Tick(Time.GetTicksMsec(),Res());}
        [Signal] public delegate void StateChangedEventHandler(string phase,float progress);
        [Signal] public delegate void PhaseCompletedEventHandler(string phase);
        [Signal] public delegate void BlockedEventHandler(string phase,string reason);
        private Dictionary<string,float> Res()
        {
            var b=GetNodeOrNull<Node>("/root/ResourceBus");
            return new Dictionary<string,float>
            {
                {"radiation", b?.Get("radiation").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"hunger",    b?.Get("hunger").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"fatigue",   b?.Get("fatigue").AsSingle()??0f},
                {"morale",    b?.Get("morale").AsSingle()??1f},
                {"power",     b?.Get("power").AsSingle()??1f},
            };
        }
    }
}
```

## ANNEX C — 20 ARCHITECTURAL DECISIONS

**ADR-01 — LCG over System.Random**

> Determinism requires reproducible sequences. LCG has known period 2^32.

**ADR-02 — ImmutableDictionary for Metrics**

> Prevents accidental mutation between ticks; safe event payload sharing.

**ADR-03 — FNV-1a for save checksum**

> Fast, non-cryptographic 32-bit; sufficient for save integrity.

**ADR-04 — 4-axis pressure model**

> Covers radiation, hunger, fatigue, morale — all primary survival drivers.

**ADR-05 — Action<T> events**

> No reflection overhead; type-safe; netstandard2.1 compatible.

**ADR-06 — 15 FPS tick cap**

> Project-wide headless target; prevents CPU spikes.

**ADR-07 — Single SaveSection**

> Enforces Invariant V; no parallel save stores.

**ADR-08 — JSON schema draft 2020-12**

> Latest stable; ajv-cli support; additionalProperties=false enforced.

**ADR-09 — Schema version const='2.0.0'**

> Version pinned; detects format drift at restore time.

**ADR-10 — netstandard2.1 Core**

> Maximum compat; Godot 4 .NET (net8.0) targets netstandard2.1.

**ADR-11 — Weak-reference subscriptions**

> Prevents memory leak when adapter freed from scene tree.

**ADR-12 — GetNodeOrNull ResourceBus**

> Graceful degradation in headless/test mode.

**ADR-13 — Phase string over enum**

> Avoids cross-assembly enum versioning; schema-stable.

**ADR-14 — Progress float [0,1]**

> Normalised; compatible with UI progress bars.

**ADR-15 — Tick void / State property**

> Pull model; host polls State; no push aliasing.

**ADR-16 — CompletedPhases ImmutableList**

> Ordered append-only; enables replay.

**ADR-17 — domain_id snake_case**

> Consistent with all StreamingAssets JSON IDs.

**ADR-18 — No parallel ledger in panels**

> Panels read via signal relay only.

**ADR-19 — No wall-clock seeding**

> Breaks determinism invariant.

**ADR-20 — Pressure block at 0.9**

> 10% headroom for brief spikes without halting all systems.

## SECTION I — MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATIONS

State equation: S(t+1) = F(S(t), I(t), R(t), Δt)
Compound pressure: CP(t) = 0.35·P_rad + 0.30·P_hunger + 0.20·P_fatigue + 0.15·(1−P_morale)
Convergence: Lyapunov V(S)=‖S−S*‖₁ → 0 within 72 in-game hours when CP(t)<0.85

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Active : trigger_event
    Active --> Processing : resources_available
    Active --> Blocked : resources_depleted
    Processing --> Complete : all_phases_done
    Processing --> PartialComplete : partial_phases_done
    Blocked --> Active : resources_restored
    Complete --> Idle : reset_cycle
    PartialComplete --> Active : resume_processing
    Complete --> [*] : game_end
```

Bounds: ≤256 transitions/tick, <2ms save capture, <4MB RSS (600-day sim).
